summary.what: Blast radius of the 2026-10-28 robots.txt rollout (#786) across every scrape-backed capability, measured instead of inferred from the two found by reading revenue data
summary.method: npm run sources:robots-check — for each data_source_type: scrape manifest, the Strale-chosen literal URLs in the manifest and the executor are checked against the source's live robots.txt using production's own parser and matcher (parseRobotsTxt, rulesFor with STRALE_ROBOTS_TOKEN, isPathAllowed), with the same access-result rules assertRobotsAllowed applies (RFC 9309 2.3.1). No credential, no production database.
summary.negative_control: price-compare, delisted on 2026-10-30 for this exact reason, is reported as not listed — the sweep agrees with a fact established independently. The 24 scrape-backed capabilities not flagged include allabolag, ABR, curia, enforcementtracker and eleven container carriers whose paths robots.txt allows, so the check is not flagging everything it touches.
summary.limits: Static by necessity, so it covers only what a literal URL can show: a target assembled from a vendor response, a redirect chain, or a host read from the database is invisible to it. It proves reachability of the page, never that the capability's output is correct.

scope.excluded_by_design: URLs whose HOST carries a placeholder are caller-directed fetches (DEC-20261023-A): the target is unknown until the call and a block is a refusal, not a fault

listed.control_flow: single fetch path, no fallback — every call refuses
listed.status: known before this sweep; DQ-42, a revenue earner, so delist-or-build is the founder's call

listed.control_flow: TARIC primary, Access2Markets fallback on throw; trade.ec.europa.eu/robots.txt disallows only /wp-login.php, so the fallback is allowed
listed.status: still answers, from a narrower source than its provenance implies; last customer call 2026-10-29T13:38Z, public pass_rate 71

listed.control_flow: carrier chosen from the ISO 6346 owner code; MAEU routes to maersk.com and is caught into tracking_unavailable, the other twelve carriers are unaffected
listed.status: quiet degradation for the largest carrier; last customer call 2026-10-30T12:24Z, public pass_rate 100

robots_unavailable.note: answered 503 on the first and third runs and 200 with a Disallow on the second, which is why unavailable is reported in its own bucket and never fails --strict
